本例选择整数溢出，ExcCode=12。它说明保存与返回机制；真实流水线的 13: This example uses integer overflow, ExcCode=12. It explains save and return. Thirteen real pipeline exception flows are separately checked by RTL assertions.
把故障位置写入 EPC，并进入异常状态。: Save the fault location in EPC and enter exception mode.
跳到 0xBFC00380，执行处理程序。: Jump to 0xBFC00380 and run the handler.
ERET 清除 EXL，回到 EPC。: ERET clears EXL and returns to EPC.
延迟槽出错时 BD=1，EPC 保存的是前一条分支的地址，返回时才能重新执行这段: A delay-slot fault sets BD=1. EPC saves the preceding branch address so return can re-execute that control flow.
普通指令出错时 EPC 就是故障指令的地址。处理软件决定如何修复或调整返回位置。: For an ordinary instruction, EPC is the faulting PC. The handler decides how to repair the fault or adjust the return address.
